negativeStock.label: Allow negative stock
negativeStock.hint: When on, you can issue more than on-hand and the balance may go negative. Default: over-issue is blocked.

privacyMode.label: Hide money figures
privacyMode.hint: Stock value, profit, and supplier/customer balances show as dots until you tap the eye. Handy when the app is open in front of customers.

startMasked.label: Start with figures hidden
startMasked.hint: Figures are hidden when the app opens and when you come back to it. When off, they show right away — figures still hide when you leave the app or after 30 seconds idle.

backup.label: Back up database
backup.hint: Save all your data — books and receipt photos together — to a single .zip file, then share it to Downloads, Drive, or Files. Keep it safe: local data is erased if the app is uninstalled.
backup.errorTooLarge: Your data ({{size}} MB) is larger than this phone can compress into one file (limit {{limit}} MB). Delete some old receipt photos or free up space, then try again.

restore.label: Restore from backup
restore.hint: Replace the app’s current data with the contents of a backup file. Everything recorded on this phone is erased and replaced by the file — use it only after losing the phone or reinstalling the app.

target.title: Which file are you restoring?
target.hint: A backup is now a single .zip file holding the books and the receipt photos together. The other options are for files made by earlier versions.
target.zipHint: One archive with everything: items, documents, customers, suppliers, cash book, and receipt photos. The file name starts with rafuf-backup and ends in .zip
target.mergedHint: A single .db file holding the books and the receipt photos together, made by an earlier app version. Its name starts with rafuf-backup and ends in .db
target.erpHint: An older erp-backup file with no receipt photos, from an earlier app version.
target.attachmentsHint: An older erp-attachments file, from an earlier app version.

preview.title: Confirm restore
preview.countsMerged: {{documents}} documents · {{items}} items · {{parties}} customers and suppliers · {{attachments}} receipt photos
preview.countsLedger: {{documents}} documents · {{items}} items · {{parties}} customers and suppliers — no receipt photos
preview.migrationNote: This backup is from an older version; the app will upgrade it after restoring.
preview.ledgerOnlyNote: This file carries no receipt photos, so some document images may not open after restoring.
preview.warning: Warning: everything recorded on this phone right now — every document, item, debt, and cash entry — is erased and replaced by this file. The app saves a safety copy of your current data before it starts; that copy is the only way back.
preview.confirmLabel: Type “{{word}}” to confirm replacing your data

progress.title: Restoring…
progress.note: Do not close the app or lock the screen until this finishes.

success.title: Restore complete
success.body: Your data has been replaced. Fully close the app and open it again for the restored data to appear.
success.attachmentsMissing: The file you restored carries no receipt photos, so some document images may not open. If you still have a receipt-photos file (erp-attachments), you can restore it from the same screen.
success.restart: Got it — I’ll close the app

error.title: Restore failed
error.safe: None of your current data was touched.
error.notSqlite: That file is not a backup from this app. Pick a file the app itself created.
error.notZip: That file is not a backup archive. If you have an older .db backup, pick it under one of the older-backup options.
error.zipMissingLedger: That is an archive, but it holds no books from this app. Pick a backup the app created (its name starts with rafuf-backup).
error.unknownSchema: That is a database file, but not one belonging to this app.
error.wrongSlotMerged: That is an older full backup in .db form. Try again and pick it under “Full backup (older .db file)”.
error.wrongSlotErp: That is an older books-only file with no receipt photos. Try again and pick it under “Books only”.
error.wrongSlotAttachments: That is an older receipt-photos file. Try again and pick it under “Receipt photos only”.
error.schemaTooNew: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app first, then try again — restoring it now could corrupt your data.
error.fileMissing: The file could not be read. It may have been moved or deleted mid-way.
error.noSpace: Not enough space on the phone to save a safety copy before restoring. Free some space and try again.
error.copyFailed: The copy stopped before it finished, and your previous data was put back.
error.migrateFailed: The file is valid but could not be upgraded to this app version, and your previous data was put back.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong during the restore.

recovery.title: A restore did not finish
recovery.body: The app closed while a backup was being restored, so the current data may be incomplete. A safety copy of your data from before that restore was kept.
recovery.unavailable: The safety copy is no longer on the phone, so there is nothing to roll back to.
recovery.doneBody: Fully close the app and open it again.
recovery.failedTitle: Could not put the data back
recovery.failedBody: The app could not restore the safety copy. Try closing the app and opening it again.

status.error: Couldn't check for updates. Tap to retry.

autoCheck.label: Check for updates on launch
autoCheck.hint: When on, the app quietly checks for a new version each time it opens and tells you when one is ready. Updates download in the background and never interrupt your work.

prompt.title: Update ready
prompt.body: A new version has been downloaded. Restart to apply it now, or keep working — it will apply the next time you open the app.
